description: Rank Sydney venues by how many dishes are free of one allergen (free by default, or able to be made free), optionally within a region or suburb and for one kind of dish. Examples: family 'gluten' in 'Northern Beaches'; family 'nuts' with dish_type 'dessert'; family 'dairy' in 'Inner West' with dish_type 'pasta'. Returns venues with their counts, links and the day each menu was read, plus example dishes when a dish type is given.

dish_type.description: Optional. A kind of dish: pasta, pizza, burger, sandwich, salad, soup, curry, noodles, dumplings, sushi, rice, steak, seafood, breakfast, dessert, ...

family.description: The allergen: gluten (coeliac), dairy, nuts, peanut, treenut, egg, soy, sesame, shellfish, fish, seafood, lupin, sulphite; or the diets vegetarian, vegan.

region.description: Optional. A Sydney region or suburb: 'Northern Beaches', 'Inner West', 'Parramatta', 'Manly'.

name: list_allergen_free
title: List allergen-free venues
